{"consolidated_memory":"File: realtime/ws/session.ts (realtime side)
Covering test: realtime/ws/session.test.ts
Stack: TypeScript

Problem: Dropped frames in websocket session
General reproduction: Hold socket open through network flap
Signal: Frames missing from client sequence

Occasion 1 [2026-02-09]:
- Specific trigger: payloads above roughly 2 megabytes
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised pool ceiling, added bounded wait queue
- PR #7121, branch fix/dropped-frames-1
- Result: throughput rose 23 percent to 682 requests per second

Occasion 2 [2026-02-13]:
- Specific trigger: only on staging read replica
- Root cause: race condition in lazy initialization
- Fix: guarded initialization with double-checked lock
- PR #7361, branch fix/dropped-frames-2
- Result: p99 latency fell from 8.6 seconds to 681 milliseconds

Occasion 3 [2026-08-08]:
- Specific trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: added composite index and backfilled data in batches
- PR #8759, branch fix/dropped-frames-3
- Result: reclaimed 48 GB of blob storage"}
